changed_conditional_fields: DB69 trailing field follows the moved script low byte.
D57C and EE65 alternate record fields follow their shared jump operands.
Audio AA49 retains its literal note encoding; its conditional target does not follow the moved AC7F label.
scope: Maintained shared-source v1.3 geometry and explicit native/data differences. Acceptance is derived from the own decoded-input build, applicable source/asset controls and evidence-bound inventory; this profile alone is not acceptance proof.
code_window_scope: Physical native source windows, checked instruction by instruction. Primary microregions are not reused after helper removal/reordering. All applicable primary source controls are retained; retired interpretations and new source components have explicit target decisions. Control coverage is derived from actual changed bytes in these windows and typed data regions.

retired_primary_controls.shift_left4: The standalone four-left-shift entry is absent. Its two callers inline four ASLs; the three-shift native entry remains. Existing caller controls and the new inline-source control replace this obsolete boundary.
retired_primary_controls.double_fe_pointer: The FE/FF doubling helper is absent; seven caller sites inline its instructions. Native source is checked per instruction, with the inline-source control.
retired_primary_controls.scale_position_by_eight: The standalone chained-shift entry is absent. Both callers inline three paired shifts, represented in the shared native-inlines source.
retired_primary_controls.shift_reference_right: The standalone reference-shift helper is absent; its three paired operations are inline in the position update.
retired_primary_controls.scale_world_shift: The standalone world-shift helper is absent. Its three accumulator/$11 shifts are inline in the source-owned coordinate function.
retired_primary_controls.shift_search_coordinate_right: The standalone search-coordinate shift is absent; its three paired shifts are inline in the source-owned bounds caller.
retired_primary_controls.shift_scrolled_slot_horizontal: The standalone horizontal-slot shift is absent; indexed paired shifts are inline in the source-owned fraction caller.
retired_primary_controls.pending_ppu_set_source: The standalone EA/EB source helper is absent. Its four instructions appear inline at both PPU consumers.
retired_primary_controls.advance_audio_command_two: There is no two-byte-advance entry. Every former call becomes two calls to the retained one-byte advance, which keeps its control.
retired_primary_controls.script_prefix_af02: The actual three-byte form is an encoded pointer to InteractionScriptAF05 and a trailing E0 field. The primary conditional branch-prefix opcode does not survive relocation. The typed pointer source has its own control.
retired_primary_controls.main_state_scale: Both standalone scroll-base doubling helpers are absent; their paired shifts occur inline in the state setup. Caller controls and the shared inline-source control cover the current representation.
